[h1]Happy Easter Ratdom,[/h1]

Spring has sprung in the Northern Wastes, and we’re celebrating with a [b]25% off sale[/b] on Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter! Now’s the perfect time to dive into our latest update, brimming with Easter-themed goodies, balance tweaks, and polish to make your adventure sharper than a rat’s claw. Hop into Update v14932 and discover what’s new!

Happy egg-hunting,
United Label & Odd Bug Studio


[h2]Patch Notes - Update V14932:[/h2]
[h3]New Easter DLC[/h3]
Get ready to crack some eggs with these festive additions: 
[list]
[*] A brittle Easter Eggshell Armour Set – this delicate gear offers minimal protection, daring bold rats to rely on skill alone. Think you’ve got what it takes to conquer the entire game wearing this and this alone?  
[*] A One-Handed Easter Sword, brimming with seasonal spirit, for slicing foes with festive flair.  
[*] Exclusive upgrade paths for both the armour and sword.

[list]

[/list]
[h3]Crafting Adjustment[/h3]
[list]
[*] Refined the crafting requirements for WereOwl Bows – now requiring beaks and feathers
[/list]
[h3]In-game Credits Adjustment:  [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added missing names to give proper shout-outs to our team.  
[*] Enhanced image quality for sharper, clearer visuals – give ‘em a look!
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in an execution animation during the combat tutorial, including Arlo’s issue with Backstabber Pups on the left edge of the arena.

notes.title: Update: 'Happy Valentails' - New DLC, Intel GPU Fix, Subtitle Adjustment & More
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/27d57e73201834bc5d90b28171dfc25fe7e0c1c6.jpg[/img]
[h3]Happy Valentails, Ratdom! ❤️🐀[/h3]
Love is in the air... and so are arrows! 💘 Whether you're braving the Northern Wastes solo or battling side-by-side with your most loyal rat companion, we’ve got a little something to help you wear your heart on your sleeve, literally!

[h3]Valentine's Day Update🏹[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Valentine's Day DLC[/b] – Dress to impress with the Cupid-themed armour set featuring a new Helmet, Pauldron, winged Cuirass, and Bow, plus full upgrade trees!
[/list][b]How to Unlock:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Game:[/b] Some items and blueprints are earned after completing the intro quest (automatically added to Inventory).
[*] [b]Existing Saves:[/b] If you've already passed the intro, the items will be automatically added to Arlo's Inventory.
[/list][h3]Integrated Intel GPU Update[/h3]
We've resolved launch crashes for systems using integrated Intel GPUs through the addition of a new Texture Quality setting from within the main menu. However, we’re also aware of Fast Travel crashes that can occur after long play sessions on those systems. Such crashes don’t corrupt saves or block progress, and are the result of a limitation of the hardware. 

[h2]Patch Notes [/h2]

[h3]New Features & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Texture Quality setting[/b] – Intel GPU users can now launch the game using the Low setting.
[*] [b]Subtitle Size setting[/b] – Adjust text size to make sure every rat gets the perfect reading experience.
[*] [b]Steam Cloud Save Support [/b]– Transfer saves seamlessly between Windows and MacOS.
[/list][h3]Fixes & Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed [/b]controller issues on MacOS (M1 and above).
[*] [b]Fixed [/b]the 'Load Game' menu not opening if a save file was corrupted.
[*] [b]Fixed [/b]a game freeze caused by Mudwyrms using the Dig circle marker attack simultaneously.
[*] [b]Fixed [/b]WereOwl Pauldron items displaying awkwardly while sprinting.
[*] [b]Adjusted[/b] crafting requirements for:
[/list]- Fire Wyrm Sting (One-Handed Spear)
- Electric Slash (One-Handed Axe)
- TH Ice Katana (Two-Handed Sword)
- TH Long Winter Slammer (Two-Handed Axe)

Stay sharp, stay fierce, and spread the love (or the carnage)! 💕⚔️

United Label & Odd Bug Studio

notes.title: 20 Reasons to Play Tails of Iron 2 - 20% OFF
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/08b9efe93264f19863db0455ebd5fcd58752101a.png[/img][h3]Greetings Ratdom,[/h3]
The next chapter in the [i]Tails of Iron[/i] saga has arrived! If you’re yet to embark on Arlo's brutal adventure and ‘tail’ of revenge against the ancient Dark Wings, we're here to give you 20 reasons why you should! 

From heart-pounding combat to breathtaking visuals, here's why [b][i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] is a must-play at 20% OFF![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473480/Tails_of_Iron_2_Whiskers_of_Winter/ 
[h3]1 - A New Hero Rises[/h3]
Step into the paws of Arlo, a young Rat warrior fighting for survival and revenge in the frozen Northern Wastes of the Ratdom. New journey, new threats… same brutal challenge.

[h3]2 - Soulslike Combat[/h3]
Parry, dodge, and strike with precision in a combat system that rewards skill and punishes hesitation. Master the dance of death, or be crushed by it.

[h3]3 - A World as Brutal as it is Beautiful[/h3]
Stunning hand drawn visuals bring the unforgiving world of the Northern Wastes to life, from icy tundras to war-torn battlegrounds.

[h3]4 - Towering Boss Battles[/h3]
Monstrous beasts, ruthless warlords, and towering nightmares. Each fight demands different tactics, so adapt or perish.

[h3]5 - A Hunt That Feels Real[/h3]
Your prey won't just lie down and die: They'll run, regroup, ambush, and try to turn the hunter into the hunted!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0o0TgU6.gif[/img] 
[h3]6 - More Factions, More Enemies[/h3]
Battle the relentless Dark Wings and form uneasy alliances with new and familiar faces. Friend or foe? Sometimes it’s both.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nrxxfkG.gif[/img] 
[h3]7 - The Legendary Doug Cockle Returns[/h3]
That gruff, unmistakable voice? Oh yeah, he’s back, narrating every triumph, every tragedy… and every gruesome death.

[h3]8 - Side Quests with Real Impact[/h3]
New beast hunt side quests offer new challenges beyond Arlo’s main storyline, with rewards worth fighting for.

[h3]9 - GRAPPLING HOOK![/h3]
Propel yourself through the world and gain access to new areas with the new-to-series grappling hook, enhancing Arlo’s traversal through the northern frontier.

[h3]10 - New Elemental Traps[/h3]
Turn the tide of battle with all-new traps imbued with fire, ice, electric, and poison, all of which can spell doom for your enemies (or for you, if you’re not careful).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/dc92e5c154b3c6dfcf616ab0c182fe4395c00b67.jpg[/img] [h3]11 - Customisable Combat Styles[/h3]
Find, upgrade, and customise your weapons and armor to fit your strategy. Light and fast or slow and tanky? The choice is yours.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Cg8NkFt.gif[/img] 
[h3]12 - Secrets Hidden in the Frost[/h3]
Hidden among the savage north you’ll find ancient tombs to unlock, legendary weapons to discover, and armor sets pulled from a whole other soulslike universe, if you know where to look.

[h3]13 - Rebuild Winter’s Edge from Devastation[/h3]
As the new Warden of the Wastes, it’s up to Arlo to return the Rat fortress of Winter’s Edge to its former glory; collect wood and mine ore throughout your adventure to rebuild the smithy, cookhouse, and much more.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QkuA0OT.gif[/img] 
[h3]14 - Elemental Weapons & Armor[/h3]
Harness fire, ice, electric, and poison with gear that enhances your strategy. The right tool can turn the tide of battle.

[h3]15 - Critics & Players Agree[/h3]
[i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] has won over critics and fans alike:

"...runs great on the Steam Deck" - [b]Steam Deck HQ[/b]
"...a great experience and a worthy follow-up to one of 2021’s standout indies" - [b]TheGamer[/b]
“Bigger, better, and packed with even funnier puns—[i]Tails of Iron 2[/i] delivers. The first game was so good I got a Redgi tattoo. No regrats.” - [b]Malewifujo (Steam Review)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/13fbbac78d89cfe667c6cc4539ae37bc0afee211.png[/img] 
[h3]16 - Master the Power of Elementa[/h3]
Control the very power of the gods with the all-new Elementa spellcasting system. From fireballs and freezing gusts to stunning lightning and draining poison - Elementa lets you devastate your foes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/5e7bc91d0379f45db6cec61988623f23dee6d44b.jpg[/img] 
[h3]17 - Challenge Yourself with Bloody Whiskers[/h3]
Think you're the toughest rat around? Prove it by playing [i]Tails of Iron 2[/i] in the ‘Bloody Whiskers’ hard difficulty for the ultimate test of skill, with even deadlier enemies and no room for mistakes.

[h3]18 - Want to Take it Easy? Play ‘Fairy Tail’ Mode[/h3]
Not every battle has to be a war! In ‘Fairy Tail’ easy difficulty mode you can enjoy the world, the story, and the adventure without the punishing challenge.

[h3]19 - A Sequel Forged by the Fans[/h3]
This isn’t just a sequel—it’s a love letter to everyone who battled the Frog threat in [i]Tails of Iron[/i]. Built on player feedback from the original game and last year’s demo, Whiskers of Winter delivers the experience fans have been waiting for!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gOi46nu.gif[/img] 
[h3]20 - 20% Off at Launch![/h3]
For a limited time, you can grab [i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] at 20% off. Don’t miss your chance to reclaim the Northern Wastes!

[h3]Ready to Join the Fight?[/h3]
Don’t miss your chance to experience this epic journey! Grab your copy today, overcome the Dark Wing threat, and prove your worth to the animalfolk across the expansive northern frontier of the Ratdom.

notes.title: Tails of Iron 2 review - a charming hack-and-slash soulslike lacking bite
notes.notes:
Spurred by his father's untimely death, Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter sees Arlo, the little rat that could, setting out on a sprawling fantasy hack-and-slash adventure. With a strong core loop, beautiful presentation, and a respectable translation of soulslike combat to a 2D game, Tails of Iron 2 comes close to greatness but is let down by a few disappointing design decisions.

notes.title: Dive Deep into the Ratdom with the all-new Gameplay Overview Trailer!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/81c7518b35262e8faa48dbced12d0ef552af5757.jpg[/img]
[h2]Hear Ye, Ratkind![/h2]
The countdown is on, Warriors of the Ratdom. 🐀 [i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] launches in just seven days on [b]January 28th[/b], inviting you to take up arms as Arlo and brave the frozen expanse of the Northern Wastes.

To get you ready for the brutal journey ahead, we’ve unveiled the [b]Gameplay Overview Trailer[/b], a thrilling look at the game’s visceral combat, powerful magic system, and high-stakes monster hunts. Check it out now and prepare to rise to the challenge!

[previewyoutube=-mj-v3CHQK8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]The Northern Wastes[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ah9UaX4.gif[/img]

The vast, unforgiving [b]Northern Wastes[/b] serve as the backdrop for this epic tale. With [b]six unique biomes[/b] ranging from frozen tundras to perilous swamplands, every step of Arlo’s journey is fraught with danger. These lands are as beautiful as they are deadly, hiding secrets, treasures, and challenges for those brave enough to explore.

[h3]A Fractured Kingdom[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gOi46nu.gif[/img]

The world of [i]Tails of Iron 2[/i] is one of struggle and survival. The devastating [b]Dark Wings[/b] have returned from myth, unleashing destruction along the Ratdom’s northern frontier. It falls to Arlo, the hardened heir of the North, to unite the scattered clans and rally them under one banner. As the new Warden of Winter’s Edge, Arlo must [b]rebuild[/b] not only his keep but also the trust of his people to stand against the returning darkness.

[h3]The Hunter and the Hunted[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0o0TgU6.gif[/img]

[b]Monstrous beasts[/b] roam the Northern Wastes, threatening the lives of its residents. By accepting contracts from locals, Arlo can embark on [b]hunts[/b] to take down these deadly creatures. Each of these challenges is a test of strength, strategy, and survival. The rewards? Rare materials to craft powerful equipment, glory to bolster Arlo’s legend, and the satisfaction of ridding the land of its greatest threats.

[h3]A Bastion Amid the Blizzard[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QkuA0OT.gif[/img]

Winter’s Edge, once a proud and mighty fortress, lies in ruins after the devastating assault of the Dark Wings. This ancient stronghold, nestled in the heart of the Northern Wastes, is the home that Arlo is sworn to [b]protect and restore[/b]. Rebuilding Winter’s Edge is no easy task, but it’s vital to reclaiming the kingdom’s former glory.

[h3]Weaponry and Armour[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Cg8NkFt.gif[/img]

Victory in [i]Tails of Iron 2[/i] depends on preparation. [b]Weapons and armour[/b] now come with [b]elemental buffs and resistances[/b], making [b]tactical decision-making[/b] more important than ever. Enemies have specific weaknesses, and choosing the right tools for the job can mean the difference between survival and defeat. From the [b]blacksmith’s forge[/b] to the battlefield, Arlo’s arsenal is key to his success.

[h3]The Power of the Gods[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nc99gyv.gif[/img]

Arlo’s journey introduces a game-changing feature: the Elementa magic system. Gifted by the ancient gods, Arlo can wield the devastating powers of:

[b]Electric[/b] ⚡: Call lightning from the heavens to stun multiple enemies.
[b]Fire[/b] 🔥: Launch searing flameblasts to incinerate foes.
[b]Ice[/b] ❄️: Unleash freezing gusts to stop enemies in their tracks.
[b]Poison[/b] ☠️: Inflict lingering damage to weaken entire groups of foes.

These abilities can be upgraded throughout the game, adding layers of depth and strategy to combat. Mastering them is essential to defeating the strongest enemies and overcoming the harshest trials.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473480/Tails_of_Iron_2_Whiskers_of_Winter?snr=2___ 
With launch day just around the corner, we can’t wait for you to step into Arlo’s boots and take on the challenges of the frozen North. From mastering brutal combat to rebuilding a kingdom and forging new alliances, [i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] promises an unforgettable adventure.

The [i]wait[/i] is nearly over. [i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] launches on 28th Jan, bringing a new chapter of brutality and bloodshed to the Ratdom. For the first time in the [i]Tails of Iron[/i] series, wield the raw power of elemental magic. notes.title: Sharpen Your Axe! Brutal Gamescom Trailer Unveils Tails of Iron 2 Release Date!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/f8e5e1a238bb830aa5e3f1d7c22a0e2dd9a837a5.png[/img]
[h3]Hear Ye, Ratkind![/h3]

A new saga is about to begin… We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] is officially launching in February 2025! Get ready to take up the mantle of Arlo, son of the Warden of the North, pick up a sharpened battle axe (or broadsword or spear… there are plenty of weapons of choice!) and defend your homeland after the devastating attack by the Dark Wings - an ancient evil from the frozen wastelands beyond.

In our brand new trailer, we’ve unveiled fresh gameplay footage showcasing Arlo’s brutal journey of survival and revenge. The Viking-esque aesthetic of this new story is emphasized by Fever Ray’s haunting 2008 track, ‘If I Had a Heart’ – we think it’s a fitting accompaniment to the harsh and unforgiving world Arlo must navigate through in the game.

[previewyoutube=Sg5FBayiuWc;full][/previewyoutube]
The new release date ensures we can provide the very best experience possible, and we absolutely cannot wait to reveal what’s in store for would-be vikings come early 2025. 

[h3]Your Feedback & Next steps[/h3]

We were truly humbled to see so many of you dive into the demo during June’s Steam Next Fest. Your enthusiasm and support means everything to us, and we’ve been listening closely to your feedback. Many of you enjoyed the new gameplay mechanics we introduced, but there was one point that needed a little attention – the weapon sharpening mechanic.

Thanks to your invaluable feedback, we’re making the following adjustments to the game at launch:

[list]
[*] Whetstones will now act more like weapon buffs; when used, they will increase the weapon's damage output for a limited time, similar to the poison mechanic in the original [i]Tails of Iron[/i].
[*] Weapons will no longer dull, resulting in bounce back and the inability to hit enemies. This has been entirely removed.
[*] Managing the ‘health’ of the whetstone is no longer a requirement.
[*] Whetstones are now purchasable at the shop and can also be found in the world and as an enemy drop.
[/list]
We believe these changes will make for a more fluid and enjoyable experience, and we’re incredibly grateful for your input, which has been essential in refining the game. With these improvements, we’re looking forward to bringing you an adventure truly worthy of the Viking sagas of old!

notes.title: Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter - Your feedback & Demo Extension
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/074c7b43844cae081e1835d9d69442a8312555bd.png[/img]
[h1]Hear ye, Ratkind…[/h1]

We are truly humbled to see so many of you play the demo for our upcoming squeak-quel, [i]Tails of Iron 2[/i], during Steam Next Fest. Your ongoing enthusiasm and support mean the absolute world to us.

[h2]Your Feedback Matters![/h2]

The Steam Next Fest was a great opportunity for us to hear your honest thoughts and feedback on our upcoming action-RPG, especially considering the new gameplay mechanics we’ve added, largely based on community responses to the original game. On the whole, we’re delighted to see an overwhelmingly positive reaction, with just one element - the weapon sharpening mechanic - seeming to need a little tweaking based on popular consensus. Having taken on board all of your feedback, we’re pleased to confirm that the whetstone sharpening will receive the following adjustments ahead of the full game’s launch later this year:

[list]
[*]Whetstones will now act more like weapon buffs; when used, they will increase the weapon's damage output for a limited time, similar to the poison mechanic in the original [i]Tails of Iron[/i].
[*]Weapons will no longer dull, resulting in bounce back and the inability to hit enemies. This has been entirely removed.
[*]Managing the ‘health’ of the whetstone is no longer a requirement.
[*]Whetstones are now purchasable at the shop and can also be found in the world and as an enemy drop.
[/list]
We strongly believe these changes significantly improve the weapon sharpening mechanic, providing further accessibility and flexibility in gameplay. We’re truly grateful for your feedback, which has again proven invaluable as we continue to refine the game. And with that in mind…

[h2]Demo Extended![/h2]

Originally, the [i]Tails of Iron 2[/i] demo was only supposed to be live for the duration of Steam Next Fest. However, due to the overwhelming response and to provide more of you with a chance to play, we’re excited to announce the demo period has been extended! This gives you more time to explore, battle, and experience the opening of Arlo’s epic saga of revenge against the devastating Dark Wings.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473480/Tails_of_Iron_2_Whiskers_of_Winter/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/5b7b42b844d5d3e23b5ec07b8d84901b6c21246e.png[/img]
[h2]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter features:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]An expanded campaign of violence and revenge[/b] 
[i]Whiskers of Winter[/i]’s ‘tail’ of Arlo’s fight against the ferocious Dark Wing Bats is an intense experience, featuring a semi-open RPG world set across six varied biomes to explore, and new animal factions to discover.

[*][b]Challenging combat[/b] 
Building upon the series’ trademark hardcore combat, [i]Tails of Iron 2[/i] features enhanced weapons gameplay, including four elemental effects (fire, ice, electricity, and poison) to imbue Arlo’s arsenal with unique abilities to use against foes.

[*][b]Giant Monster Hunting Side Quests[/b] 
To tip the balance against the new fanged army of Dark Wing Bats, Arlo can track down and overcome 15 gigantic and challenging beasts to harvest their cadavers for rare upgrade materials.

[*][b]Improved base building[/b] 
Construct and upgrade the devastated settlement of Winter’s Edge to gain access to more powerful items from the smithy, tastier meals at the kitchen, a wider range of powerful traps from the shoppe, and more!

[*][b]Day and night system[/b] 
Arlo will face different foes depending on the time of day, with more enemy types added as additional monsters are hunted down and vanquished.
[/list]

Unfortunately, or fortunately for those brave enough, there are a plethora of gigantic beasts to hunt down - each with their own distinct battle styles and challenges, requiring all your whit and battle prowess to overcome. However, if you choose to track and slay these beasts you will not go unrewarded for each foe you fell, you will be able to harvest the spoils of their carcasses for rare upgrade materials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/ee87f048c85e474d586032df5ac214200ea730a5.png[/img]
[b]Grapple Hook[/b]
With Tails of Iron 2 we wanted to make traveling feel more fluid, adding not only speed but verticality to the map, with the use of a grapple hook - but fret not, you will also find the grapple hook will come handy when performing final executions.

[b]Base building[/b]
As you can see Winters Edge took a hit with the last attack from the Dark Wings, your task as the new Warden of the Wastes is to rebuild your settlement - doing so will allow access to an upgraded smithy, tastier meals at the kitchen, alongside a wider range of powerful traps from the shop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/c869368630f0a2ad842cc7c9327e3a1673e5a9a9.png[/img]
We hope to see you in the Wastes soon, our loyal rodents!

notes.title: TAILS OF IRON 2: WHISKERS OF WINTER ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/973407c3420b6d4bc6a4e2a28a31789d7b30b602.png[/img]
[h3]Greetings all Ratkind,[/h3]
A great threat looms in the North, and all that stands in its way is one Rat, hardened by the harshest of environments. Set after the bloody conclusion of the original game, [i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] sees Arlo, son of the Warden of the North, embark on a violent quest of ruthless revenge against the Dark Wings’ onslaught, while introducing new fearsome monster-hunting sidequests against gigantic beasts.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473480/Tails_of_Iron_2_Whiskers_of_Winter/

To aid in the pursuit of vengeance, Arlo can imbue his weapons with a range of new elemental effects and abilities, ensuring his success against the scum that plagues his lands. However, as a result of the chaos brought upon the North, Arlo must rebuild the Northern Garrison of Winter’s Edge with the use of the enhanced settlement mechanics. All the while, the region’s new protector must explore new and distinct areas of the frontier, home to a new cast of critters, some to ally with... others, to vanquish.

[i]A new and violent ‘tail’ begins…[/i]

[previewyoutube=-xniRGcL_wM;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]“We are delighted to finally announce our return to Ratdom with Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter, and start a new ‘tail’ of bloodshed and medieval revenge. We wanted to build upon what we achieved with the first instalment and create a game that was more than just a straightforward sequel,”[/i] said Jack Bennett, Co-founder and Lead Designer, Odd Bug Studio. [i]“We took on board the incredible community feedback on the original game and set about crafting a more intense experience than its predecessor. The new gameplay mechanics, the addition of monster hunting sidequests, together with improved crafting and base building, all work together to make Arlo’s crusade in the northern wastelands even more epic than King Redgi’s.” [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/95b0bb3290df9bd9753bc6dbfa452eba4f667842.jpg[/img]
[h3]Tails of Iron 2: Whispers of Winter features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]An expanded campaign of violence and revenge[/b] – Whiskers of Winter’s ‘tail’ of Arlo’s fight against the ferocious Dark Wing Bats is an intense experience, featuring a semi-open RPG world set across six varied biomes to explore, and new animal factions to discover. 
[*] [b]Challenging combat[/b] – Building upon the series’ trademark hardcore combat, Tails of Iron 2 features enhanced weapons gameplay, including four elemental effects (fire, ice, electricity, and poison) to imbue Arlo’s arsenal with unique abilities to use against foes. 
[*] [b]NEW Monster hunting gameplay[/b] – To tip the balance against the new fanged army of Dark Wing Bats, Arlo can track down and overcome 15 gigantic and challenging beasts to harvest their cadavers for rare upgrade materials.  
[*] [b]Improved base building[/b] – Construct and upgrade the devastated settlement of Winter’s Edge to gain access to more powerful items from the smithy, tastier meals at the kitchen, a wider range of powerful traps from the shop, and more! 
[*] [b]NEW Day and night system[/b] – Arlo will face different foes depending on the time of day, with more enemy types added as additional monsters are hunted down and vanquished. 
[/list]

notes.title: One of the best indie soulslike games is back with a frosty sequel
notes.notes:
Amid the many excellent 2D indie games that make use of soulslike exploration and combat, Odd Bug Studio's Tails of Iron is one of my personal favorites. Its beautiful art design and satisfying combat - especially in its boss fights - puts it up there with the likes of Blasphemous 2, Hollow Knight, and Salt and Sanctuary. I'm very excited, then, by the news that Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter will see the series make a triumphant return to Steam, along with its iconic narrator Doug Cockle, best known as the VA behind The Witcher's Geralt of Rivia and Bhaal in Baldur's Gate 3.
